title: Perfil de confiança ladder
summary: The full trust ladder of the current account (ADR 0019): every step with its name, what it proves and its status. It opens from trust-card. Only the account owner sees it.

isCompany.description: Company account. Selects the company ladder.

steps.description: The same steps as trust-card, in order.

openClaim.effect: Company account: a tap on the cnpj, proof or domain step opens business-claim (bipe-chat/bipe#249). Those steps are todo until done.

openGovbr.effect: Personal account, step 5 todo (build flag govbrEnabled on): a tap on the govbr step opens govbr-verify (bipe-chat/bipe#544). The only entry to that flow.

notes: Navigation title bipe_trust_title. A header with the progress bar and bipe_trust_progress, one row per step, then bipe_trust_footer.

Step row: number, title (bipe_trust_step_<id>), body (bipe_trust_step_<id>_body; profile on a company account uses bipe_trust_step_company_profile_body) and a status mark. done: a check icon; screen readers hear bipe_trust_step_done as the row value. todo: no mark; under the profile step, one action row per missingProfileItems entry. comingSoon: the text bipe_trust_coming_soon in secondary ink.
Never colour alone (trust-ui.md): every status has an icon or words. The check mark is not the Bipe seal.
The state is the same BipeTrustProfile value as trust-card; this screen reads it, it does not fetch on its own.
No step shows a CPF, a document or the verified name of another person (ADR 0019).
govbr: todo when the build flag govbrEnabled is on, else comingSoon; done when the account's own badge level is govbr (trust-card notes). A done or comingSoon govbr row opens nothing.
